description: Staged Exposure Pilot Charter and Non-Goals

stages.S-0: Shadow Mode (Internal logging only; zero user impact)
stages.S-1: Opt-In Limited Pilot (Explicit bilingual consent; 100% Document KYC active)
stages.S-2: Limited Production Enforcement (Gated on N=200 in-domain cohort + Ethics Approval)

non_goals: No Aadhaar Face RD compliance is claimed or represented
No automated permanent worker ban based on biometric mismatch
No biometric surveillance or background face identification
